name: STAR Geodesy — Lambert conformal conic
summary: Lambert conformal conic projection, forward, inverse and scale factor, for cones in either hemisphere and the tangent cone; within 8e-7 m per Earth radius of PROJ and 7e-6 m of PyGeodesy on 600 cases; reproduces Snyder's published example and refuses degenerate cones.
reference: Snyder, Map Projections - A Working Manual (USGS PP 1395), p. 296: Clarke 1866, parallels 33 N and 45 N, origin 23 N 96 W, point 35 N 75 W: x = 1894410.9 m, y = 1564649.5 m, k = 0.9970171

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees and metres; x East, y North, no false origin; the ellipsoid is an explicit argument
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for degenerate cones; Newton iteration capped at 10 steps
